Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) BIS LICENSE: Bidders must enclose valid BIS License along with their bid, otherwise their offer will be su mmarily rejected without any back reference. 2) Performance for similar item means Split Air Conditioning machine or Unitary Air Conditioning (Window AC) machine with different capacity. 3) inspection clause- Inspection by RITES . 4) BEE Certificate-Firm to submit BEE certificate of their offered model at the time of inspection. 5) The Authorized dealer/agent of OEM must upload tender specific authorization along with the bid, failing which their offer will be summarily rejected. 6) In case tenderer participates as an authorized agent, then the performance as required above shall be t hat of Principal authorizing the agent. AC are required 18m suitable copper pipe roll along with suitable cable from indoor to outdoor(1m for each AC ) 9m suitable 3x4sqmm copper power cable (0.5m for each AC). If extra pipe,cable not required then that to be handed over to consignee. 18 pair stand &18 nos 15 A top( 1pair stand ,1 no top for each ac) If not required then that to be handed over to consignee. Drain pipe 54 m (3m for each ac) Proper wrapping and insulation needed. f. Payment Terms will be indicate in P.O: 80% payment against supply and 20% payment will be made afte r completion of installation. 8) Description:Supply and installation of Split Air-Conditioner of BEE 5-star rating, wit h rated standard cooling capacity of minimum 5200 Watt, with the function of Coolin g only, with Rotary Compressor, Inverter (Variable speed) Type, suitable for 230 V AC , 50 Hz System, with 100% Copper Coil, Eco friendly Refrigerant, Anti-Freeze Thermo stat, with thermal protection for blower motor & condenser motor. Conforming to BIS Specification no. IS:1391 (Part-2) 2023 & ISI marked. BEE 5-star rating must comply t o Ministry of Power notification no. S.O. 2794(E) dated 16th July, 2024 & S.O. 3984(E) dated 28th August, 2025 or latest with minimum Indian Seasonal Energy Efficiency R atio of 5.6 or latest. Refrigerant Copper pipes (suction & return) of minimum 4-meter length each, Nitrile rubber Tube with Density 55 Kg/Cubic meter or more, Fire perfor mance Class 1, Rate of burning Class V-0, Water vapour diffusion resistance factor (μ ) more than 12000, service temperature 10 to 105-degree C, Surface flame spread Cl ass 1 & thickness of minimum ½ inch, relevant test certificates to be submitted. Nitril e rubber Tube shall be with suitable inner diameter to suit & to wrap the complete le ngth of refrigerant copper pipe and Aluminium foil lamination of 0.2 mm thick to cove r entire length of the Copper refrigerant pipes will be supplied along with each Air-co nditioner. Following has to be submitted by firm along with the offer in tender: a. Vali d BIS License Certificate of OEM for the offered product conforming to IS 1391 (part- 2). BIS Certificate of Third Party Manufacturer shall not be considered. b. Valid BEE St ar Rating Certificate for the offered product with same make & model no. c. Type Tes t Report for the offered product with same make & model no. Conforming to IS:1391 Part-2 from NABL Accredited lab. Warranty: Compressor will have 10 years warranty, PCBs will have 5 years warranty, Complete Air-conditioner will have minimum 1 year warranty. .
